result.rationale: The diff shows `rss.items.each do |i|` with no rescue around `i.content.scrub` in poll_feed, and `sidekiq_options retry: false`. SimpleRSS exposes elements via method_missing, so an item lacking a content element (e.g., RSS 2.0 description-only items) would raise NoMethodError, aborting the loop; with retry disabled the failure is silent. The core mechanism (no per-item error handling + no retry in a scheduled job) is fully visible in the diff; the exact exception for missing content depends on simple-rss internals not shown, so confidence is moderate.

judged_text: poll_feed iterates rss.items with no per-item error handling inside a job declared `sidekiq_options retry: false`, and line 35 assumes every feed item exposes a `content` element (`i.content.scrub`), which standard RSS 2.0 description-only items do not. One malformed or content-less item raises NoMethodError, aborting the run at that item on this and every subsequent hourly invocation, so all items after it are never imported; with retry disabled the failure surfaces only in the sidekiq dead set, not to the admin who enabled feed polling.
